L27·N4866unmasked layer
This neuron fires at boundary tokens right where a specific name/technical compound is being introduced — punctuation like the period in "Mr." or the comma ending an introductory clause, the space before a year, and the first/joining piece of a proper or compound noun ("Digital" Republik, "Shaft"less, Bore"well") — while function words and mid-brand continuations ("of", "a", "the", "gear" in Netgear) strongly suppress it.
